run_train_t2i_adapter_sdxl: run the T2I-Adapter SDXL training script with pretrained model and dataset arguments
parse_training_arguments: parse command-line arguments for T2I-Adapter SDXL training configuration and validation
encode_text_prompts: encode text prompts using dual CLIP text encoders with pooled embeddings for SDXL
validate_trained_adapter: validate a trained T2I-Adapter by generating images with conditioning inputs and logging results
save_model_card_hub: save a model card README and upload trained T2I-Adapter weights to the Hugging Face Hub
